annotations.title: Get a link to the full Competitive Hiring Report

description: Returns a link for the person who will use the full Competitive Hiring Report for a posting (first report free). They open it on veritahire.com with the posting already filled in, enter their own work email, and get the report. This tool sends no email and takes no email address: VeritaHire only emails the address the person types there.
